<!-- pr-reviewer: e7aef8523a40913be02cb07b7ecb9729d38f048c -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge into `site/v0.26.0`.

Review scope:
- Read all six changed files and the requirements on #3769. No earlier review exists.
- Checked the project laws from current `upstream/main` at `79d47c28229aaad15a564c82d0214debae0473ef`.
- The inventory matches all 26 supplied post scripts and 50 machine files. The guide distinguishes templates from accepted machine configurations.
- Checked the outline MCP arguments, profile limits, protection controls, native Agie limits, and project format against the released tree.
- The five requested subjects have documentation and test coverage. The separate main PR explains the `Refs #3769` footer.

Local results:
- Worktree: `.claude/worktrees/review-3771`, branch `review-3771`.
- Target base: `upstream/site/v0.26.0` at `46957f4a7252cb80dfa09e55a36bf1465d179f17`.
- Trial merge: `git merge --no-ff --no-edit upstream/site/v0.26.0` reported `Already up to date.` The base is already the PR parent. HEAD is the reviewed PR head; no merge commit was needed.
- `ZOLA=/tmp/review-3771-tools/zola python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests`: 99 passed, 0 failed.
- Zola 0.23.6 archive passed the workflow SHA-256 check. The first run lacked Zola. The complete run passed after this local environment correction.
- `git diff --check upstream/site/v0.26.0...HEAD`: passed.

Extra suites run: the full site suite includes the five new `Release026Gaps` tests and the Zola rendering tests.

Safety tier: not applicable. Only documentation and site tests changed. No posted output, geometry, collision checks, simulation, recorded programs, or goldens changed.
Mutations: not run by this reviewer; no safety code changed.
Cargo gates, heavy lanes, Clippy, importer suites, and the app catalog were not run. This site-only change does not reach them.
No UI code changed, so app screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge: none.

The review worktree and branch remain in place for the next round. No code was changed or pushed.
A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
